notes.title: First Post!
notes.content:
Hello! This is June from JK Games!

I'm delighted to announce that we're now able to start writing our first post. Going forward, we plan to provide regular updates summarizing our progress, among other things, once a week.

Here's the current status of the game:

[list]
[*] 15 unique heroes
[*] 5 items
[*] 4 maps
[*] 9 blessings
[*] 5 events
[/list]
Currently, we have set a release date for the game in mid-October. We will launch in Early Access with a total of 22 unique heroes, 10 items, 5 maps, 15 blessings, and 10 events.

We look forward to sharing more with you next week!

----
If you have any question/comment feel free to ask in https://discord.gg/239V8frXpP
